The delicate golden pendant necklace catches the festive lights without overpowering your vibrant look, while the sleek brown satchel adds a touch of understated elegance as it complements your rich burgundy dress shoes that give you height and confidence.", "how_to_wear": ["Pair this playful yet polished look with a little extra sparkle in your hair or makeup to stand out during the celebration", "If you need to dance, slip the dress into an underlayer if needed to keep comfort all night", "The bold red tones of the dress work beautifully with warm evening lighting and holiday decorations"], "wrong_photos": [], "swap": {}, "named": [{"n": "#122·25", "what": "Coral floral cocktail dress"}, {"n": "#269·32", "what": "Golden heart pendant necklace"}, {"n": "#405·07", "what": "Brown leather satchel bag"}, {"n": "#17·21", "what": "Burgundy brogue dress shoes"}], "about_items": [{"n": "#122·25", "text": "This vibrant coral cocktail dress features an elegant sweetheart neckline and a fitted bodice that transitions into a flared skirt with black floral prints for sophisticated contrast."}, {"n": "#269·32", "text": "The delicate golden necklace showcases a minimalist heart-shaped pendant that sits perfectly at the collarbone to draw attention to your neckline."}, {"n": "#405·07", "text": "This structured tan leather satchel bag features gold-tone hardware and a distinctive logo charm that adds character while maintaining professional polish."}, {"n": "#17·21", "text": "These burgundy leather brogue shoes combine classic wingtip detailing with chunky soles for both style and comfort throughout your evening."}], "day": ["New Year corporate event at casual restaurant"], "palette": [], "body": [], "shape": []}
